def blockColor : List (List Nat) → Nat → Nat

  | b :: bs, x => if b.contains x then b.headD 0 else blockColor bs x

theorem checked_flatten_nodup (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
    (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) P = true) : P.flatten.Nodup := by
  apply List.nodup_iff_count_of_mem.2
  intro x hx
  have hs := partitionCheck_subset _ P hp hx
  have hh : (leaves S).all (fun x => P.flatten.count x == 1) = true := by
    simp only [partitionCheck,Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
    exact hp.1.2
  exact beq_iff_eq.1 (List.all_eq_true.1 hh x hs)

theorem checked_rank (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
    (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) P = true) : inputRank S (blockColor P) = P.length := by
  have hn := checked_flatten_nodup S P hp
  have he := partitionCheck_nonempty _ P hp
  have hrep := representative_nodup P hn he
  have hperm : (dedupNat ((leaves S).map (blockColor P))).Perm
      (P.map (fun b => b.headD 0)) := by
    apply (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (dedupNat_nodup _) hrep).2
    intro i
    rw [mem_dedupNat]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨x,hx,hxi⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hi
      obtain ⟨b,hb,hxb⟩ := Integration.partitionCheck_covers _ P hp x hx
      exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨b,hb,(color_of_mem P hn b hb x hxb).symm.trans hxi⟩
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨b,hb,hbi⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hi
      have hh := head_mem b (he b hb)

def BlockPermutation (P Q : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : List Nat → List Nat, (Q.map f).Perm P ∧ ∀ b, b ∈ Q → (f b).Perm b

theorem checked_block_permutation (S : Tree) (P Q : List (List Nat))
    (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) P = true) (hq : partitionCheck (leaves S) Q = true)
    (hmq : ∀ b, b ∈ Q → LabelMonochromatic (blockColor P) b)
    (hlq : Q.length = P.length) : BlockPermutation P Q := by
  have hnP := checked_flatten_nodup S P hp
  have hnQ := checked_flatten_nodup S Q hq
  have hrep := representative_nodup P hnP (partitionCheck_nonempty _ P hp)
  let f := fun b : List Nat => blockForKey P (blockColor P (b.headD 0))
  have hfP : P.map f = P := by
    calc P.map f = P.map id := by
           apply List.map_congr_left
           intro b hb
           have hh := head_mem b (partitionCheck_nonempty _ P hp b hb)
           dsimp [f]
           rw [color_of_mem P hnP b hb _ hh]
           exact blockForKey_head P hrep b hb
         _ = P := List.map_id P
  have hkeys := representative_colors_perm S (blockColor P) P Q hp hq

theorem recover_checked (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
    (hn : (leaves S).Nodup) (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) P = true)
    (he : pairwiseEmbeddings S P = true) :
    ∃ o, recover S P = some o ∧
      (generate S (blockColor P) (P.length - 1)).outputs = [o] ∧
      o.sourceCuts.length = P.length - 1 ∧ o.partition.length = P.length ∧
      CutRealization.RealizedOutput S o ∧ BlockPermutation P o.partition ∧
      partitionCheck (leaves S) o.partition = true := by
  have hr := checked_rank S P hp
  have hf : RankFeasible S (blockColor P) :=
    ⟨P,hp,he,checked_monochromatic S P hp,hr.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨o,ho,hcost⟩ := feasible_unique S (blockColor P) hn hf (P.length - 1) (by omega)
  have hmem : o ∈ (generate S (blockColor P) (P.length - 1)).outputs := by rw [ho]; simp
  have hcheck := CutRealization.generate_partition_check S (blockColor P) _ o hmem
  have hmono := CutRealization.generate_monochromatic S (blockColor P) _ o hmem
  have hpcount := generate_partition_cost S (blockColor P) _ o hmem
  have hpos := inputRank_pos S (blockColor P)
  have hc : o.sourceCuts.length = P.length - 1 := by omega

theorem recover_sound (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat)) (o : Output)
    (ho : recover S P = some o) :
    CutRealization.RealizedOutput S o ∧ o.sourceCuts.length = P.length - 1 ∧
      o.partition.length = P.length ∧ BlockPermutation P o.partition ∧
      partitionCheck (leaves S) o.partition = true := by
  obtain ⟨hn,hp,he⟩ := recover_some_guards S P o ho
  obtain ⟨o',ho',_,hc,hl,hr,hperm,hcheck⟩ := recover_checked S P hn hp he
  have heq : o' = o := Option.some.inj (ho'.symm.trans ho)
  subst o'
  exact ⟨hr,hc,hl,hperm,hcheck⟩

theorem recover_success_iff (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat)) :
    (∃ o, recover S P = some o) ↔ inputCheck S P = true := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨o,ho⟩
    exact (inputCheck_iff S P).2 (recover_some_guards S P o ho)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hn,hp,he⟩ := (inputCheck_iff S P).1 h

    exact ⟨o,ho⟩

theorem recover_original_agreement (T S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
    (hn : (leaves S).Nodup) (ha : agreement T S P = true) :
    ∃ o, recover S P = some o ∧ agreement T S o.partition = true ∧
      o.sourceCuts.length = P.length - 1 ∧ o.partition.length = P.length ∧
      CutRealization.RealizedOutput S o ∧ BlockPermutation P o.partition := by
  have hag := ha
  simp only [agreement,Bool.and_eq_true] at hag
  obtain ⟨o,ho,_,hc,hl,hr,hperm,_⟩ := recover_checked S P hn hag.1.1.1.2 hag.2
  exact ⟨o,ho,(agreement_block_permutation T S P o.partition hperm) ▸ ha,hc,hl,hr,hperm⟩

theorem accepted_guards (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat)) (o : Output)
    (ho : recover S P = some o) :
    (leaves S).Nodup ∧ P.flatten.Nodup ∧
    (∀ b, b ∈ P → b ≠ []) ∧
    (∀ x, x ∈ leaves S → P.flatten.count x = 1) ∧
    (∀ x, x ∈ P.flatten → x ∈ leaves S) ∧ pairwiseEmbeddings S P = true := by
  obtain ⟨hn,hp,he⟩ := recover_some_guards S P o ho
  refine ⟨hn,checked_flatten_nodup S P hp,partitionCheck_nonempty _ P hp,?_,?_,he⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hh : (leaves S).all (fun x => P.flatten.count x == 1) = true := by
      simp only [partitionCheck,Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
      exact hp.1.2
    exact beq_iff_eq.1 (List.all_eq_true.1 hh x hx)
  · intro x hx
    exact partitionCheck_subset _ P hp hx

def meterColor : List (List Nat) → Nat → ColorMeasured
  | [], _ => ⟨0,1⟩
  | b :: P, x =>
    if b.contains x then ⟨b.headD 0,8*(b.length+1)+2⟩
    else let r := meterColor P x
         ⟨r.value,8*(b.length+1)+r.work+2⟩

theorem meterColor_work (P : List (List Nat)) (x : Nat) :
    (meterColor P x).work ≤ 32*(P.flatten.length+P.length+1) := by
  induction P with
  | nil => simp [meterColor]
  | cons b P ih =>
    simp only [meterColor]
    split <;> simp only [List.flatten_cons,List.length_append,List.length_cons]
    · omega
    · omega

theorem total_color_work (P : List (List Nat)) (xs : List Nat) :
    (xs.map (fun x => (meterColor P x).work)).sum ≤
      32*xs.length*(P.flatten.length+P.length+1) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := meterColor_work P x
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,List.length_cons]
    have hh := Nat.add_le_add hx ih
    have he : 32*(P.flatten.length+P.length+1) +
        32*xs.length*(P.flatten.length+P.length+1) =
        32*(xs.length+1)*(P.flatten.length+P.length+1) := by
      simp only [Nat.mul_add,Nat.add_mul,Nat.mul_one]
      omega
    exact he ▸ hh

    (hn : (leaves S).Nodup) (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) P = true) :

  apply List.perm_iff_count.2
  intro x

theorem final_work_bound (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
    (hn : (leaves S).Nodup) (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) P = true)
    (he : pairwiseEmbeddings S P = true) :
    (meterRecover S P).work ≤ finalPolynomial S P * 2^(P.length - 1) := by
  have hflat := (checked_flatten_perm S P hn hp).length_eq
  have hcount := blocks_le_flatten P (partitionCheck_nonempty _ P hp)
  have hpos := RankDichotomy.inputRank_pos S (blockColor P)
  rw [checked_rank S P hp] at hpos
  have hcap : min (P.length - 1) ((leaves S).length - 1) = P.length - 1 := by omega
  have hguard := (inputCheck_iff S P).2 ⟨hn,hp,he⟩
  have hcore := generate_work_bound S (blockColor P) (P.length - 1)
  rw [hcap] at hcore
  have hfactor : (cap (inputResource S)+6)*(P.length - 1+1)*2^(P.length - 1+1) =
      (2*(cap (inputResource S)+6)*P.length)*2^(P.length - 1) := by
    have hlen : P.length - 1+1 = P.length := by omega
    rw [Nat.pow_succ,hlen]
    ac_rfl
  rw [hfactor] at hcore

theorem final_work_absorbed (S : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
    (hn : (leaves S).Nodup) (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) P = true)
    (he : pairwiseEmbeddings S P = true) (q : Nat) (hq : P.length - 1 ≤ q)
    (c : Rat) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    ((meterRecover S P).work : Rat) ≤ (finalPolynomial S P : Rat)*c^q := by
  have hnat := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.2 (final_work_bound S P hn hp he)
  rw [Rat.natCast_mul,Rat.natCast_pow] at hnat
  have hbase := qpow_base_mono 2 c (by decide) hc (P.length - 1)
  have hexp := SourceCoverage.qpow_mono c (by grind) hq
  have hpow := Rat.le_trans hbase hexp
  have hpoly : 0 ≤ (finalPolynomial S P : Rat) := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.2 (Nat.zero_le _)
  exact Rat.le_trans hnat (Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hpoly)

def RealizedOutput (T : Tree) (o : Output) : Prop :=
  GoodCuts o.sourceCuts ∧
  (∀ p, p ∈ o.sourceCuts → Valid T p) ∧
  ∃ components : List (RMAF.Vertex × List Nat),
    components.map Prod.fst = o.sourceCuts ++ [[]] ∧
    components.map Prod.snd = o.partition ∧
    (∀ r L, (r,L) ∈ components → ComponentLabels T o.sourceCuts r L) ∧
    (components.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    (∀ v, Valid T v → ∃ r, r ∈ components.map Prod.fst ∧ ResidualWalk T o.sourceCuts r v) ∧
    (∀ r, r ∈ components.map Prod.fst → ∀ s, s ∈ components.map Prod.fst →
      (ResidualWalk T o.sourceCuts r s ↔ r = s)) ∧
    (∀ v, Valid T v → ∃ a x, LeafAt T a x ∧ ResidualWalk T o.sourceCuts v a) ∧
    o.partition.length = o.sourceCuts.length + 1
